messages:
Sam O: Planning thread for Partner Z EU-first rollout. Need canary slices, A/B check, flag name, telemetry contract, and fast fallback runbook. Whoan own?
Lina V: Proposal: micro-canary 3% for 1.5h -> eu-20% for 12h + A/B 50/50 during that window on 10k requests -> eu-60% hold 24h. Block campaigns while canary runs.
Greg H: Tech: pin `pz_partnerz.eu.v1-q` (quantized). Pre-warm EU pool, set burst reserve +30%. Flag naming: `pz.partnerz.eu.optin.v1`.
Nora T: SRE gates: auto-rollback if 5xx >0.7% for 3m OR p95 latency rises >25% vs baseline for 5m OR A/B semantic delta worse by >4%. Manual kill-switch in Console must flip to `model-global-safe` <20s.
Sam O: Ownership: Product drafts telemetry appendix; Eng-Platform creates flag + webhook; SRE owns SLOs/rollback; Ops runs cutover.
Lina V: Telemetry ask from Partner Z: per-tenant latency histogram, error rate, and up to 100 sanitized samples/day for first 48h. Delivery: daily digest T+1..T+3 then 72h cadence for 2 weeks. Retention: samples 14d, aggregates 90d. Legal must sign DPA.
Greg H: Console can send webhooks and rotate keys. We'll provide sanitized schema and PII-stripping. Canary JSON for Console:
```
{"canary":[{"slice":"rand-3pct","dur":"90m"},{"slice":"eu-20pct","dur":"12h","ab_test":{"enabled":true,"split":"50-50","sample_size":10000}},{"slice":"eu-60pct","dur":"24h"}],"fallback":"model-global-safe","prewarm":true}
```
Nora T: Rollback automation sequence: 1) disable flag slices; 2) route affected traffic to `model-global-safe`; 3) scale down variant; 4) page oncall. Add a no-promo calendar check before auto-rollback allowed.
SRE-bot: checklist created: flag + canary config + SLOs + kill-switch test required before cutover.
Sam O: Proposed cutover Friday 09:00 UTC pending signoffs. Please confirm by Wednesday EOD. Who volunteers to test kill-switch in staging? @Nora T / @Greg H?
Nora T: I'll run kill-switch test Thursday 14:00 UTC and post logs.
Greg H: I'll prepare prewarm script and heatmap outputs (latency by AZ + token-cost delta) at T+6h and T+24h.
deploy-bot: checkpoint saved: canary-plan/partnerz-eu/1795551234 by Sam O
Sam O: Final actions: Product -> telemetry appendix + DPA chase; Eng-Platform -> flag, webhook, prewarm; SRE -> SLOs + rollback automation; Ops -> schedule cutover. EOD Wednesday for approvals. :thumbsup:
